title: Northbeam TechWorks Business Desk: The Share of Rebilled Labour Included Visits Relieve
content:
The share of the chargeable labour that a business contract's included visits relieve on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on how many attendances the labour rebilled covers.

The attendances rebilled are counted from the labour entries standing on the job other than those booked for the day it was completed and those booked on the day the relief is granted, and never fall below nothing.

**Where visits stand creditable and the labour rebilled covers more than one attendance day**, the visits creditable are set against the attendances rebilled and the share is the attendances they cover divided by the attendances rebilled. The visits creditable cover no more attendances than there are rebilled, so the share never exceeds the whole.

**Where visits stand creditable and the labour rebilled covers one attendance day**, the whole of the labour rebilled is relieved.

**Where neither situation holds**, the share is the proportion the visits standing in the pool bear to the visits the service includes in its visit term, counted as at least one visit.

## The readings side by side

| Visits creditable | Attendances rebilled | The share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | two or more | the attendances the creditable visits cover, divided by the attendances rebilled |
| one or more | exactly one | the whole of the labour rebilled |
| none | any | the visits standing in the pool divided by the visits the service includes in its visit term, that divisor counted as at least 1 |
| one or more | none | the same proportion as the line above |

The divisor of the last reading is the visits the service includes in its visit term, and where a service includes none it is counted as 1 visit rather than nothing.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**Two visits creditable, three attendances rebilled.** The visits cover 2 of the 3 attendances rebilled, so the share is 2 divided by 3.

**Four visits creditable, three attendances rebilled.** The visits cover no more attendances than there are rebilled, so they cover 3 of 3 and the share is the whole.

**Two visits creditable, one attendance rebilled.** The whole of the labour rebilled is relieved.

**No visit creditable, 3 standing in the pool, a service including 4 visits in its term.** The share is 3 divided by 4.

**No visit creditable, 1 standing in the pool, a service including none in its term.** The divisor is counted as 1, so the share is 1 divided by 1, the whole.
